base_intake.interpretation: Canonical base intake is the preserved broad discovery baseline. It is not treated as a historical completeness proof.

within_year_temporal_skew_audit.diagnostic_slices: calendar quarters and months; audit-only, not publication units
within_year_temporal_skew_audit.assessment: No catastrophic temporal hole is visible in the base arXiv intake. All quarters are substantial; Q4 is about 34% denser than Q1. The more material completeness risk is query capping in dense categories rather than a missing calendar interval.

arxiv_cap_audit.assessment: 23 month/category slices hit the configured 2,000-result ceiling. Therefore base arXiv success cannot establish research completeness. Material papers must be checked by targeted primary-paper identity.

source_planes.notes: Base OpenAI RSS preserves exact 2023 GPT-4, plugins/function-calling, GPT-4V, DALL-E 3 and DevDay items. Anthropic and Google exact historical item pages are added because current index snapshots do not prove item-level historical completeness.
Targeted exact first-party pages cover LLaMA/Llama 2/Code Llama, Falcon, Mistral/Mixtral, Qwen and Yi family chronology; paper identities remain independently available from arXiv where present.

Base OpenAI RSS covers DALL-E 3; exact first-party Stability AI, Adobe, Meta AudioCraft and Runway pages fill image/video/audio product and availability chronology.

Mixtral and Mamba mark late-year movement beyond a single dense-Transformer design space. Mamba is specifically gap-filled because the capped December cs.LG slice omitted it.

residual_limitations: Official index snapshots are present-day observations and cannot prove that every 2023 item remains linked by the current publisher index.
Twenty-three capped arXiv month/category slices may omit non-headline research. Targeted primary-paper checks mitigate material editorial gaps but do not make the arXiv intake exhaustive.
GitHub release collection can miss commit-level milestones in projects whose historically important transitions were not formal Releases.
Uneven publisher archival quality means absence from a current site or index is not evidence that an event did not occur.

single_volume_preliminary_assessment.rationale: The year contains multiple interacting technical trajectories rather than two independent eras. Current evidence suggests a coherent annual story from model-centric chat systems toward a layered ecosystem spanning open weights, multimodality, tool/action interfaces, efficient runtime/adaptation, generative media, evaluation and safety.
